objective: Auditar READ_ONLY la coherencia entre CavaSocios_Movimientos.GeneroCargo/MontoCargo y CavaSocios_Cargos antes de Gate13B R2. Confirmar definicion fisica de columnas, defaults/nullability, valores existentes, movimientos de consumo con y sin cargo, cargos asociados por MovimientoID y discrepancias. No mutar datos ni codigo ni Produccion.

queries.name: cargo_movement_column_definition
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.precision,c.scale,c.is_nullable,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON c.user_type_id=t.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON c.default_object_id=dc.object_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos') AND c.name IN (N'GeneroCargo',N'MontoCargo',N'CargoConceptoID',N'MovimientoID',N'TipoMovimiento') ORDER BY c.column_id;

queries.name: cargo_movement_existing_values
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CONVERT(varchar(36),MovimientoID) AS MovimientoID,CONVERT(varchar(36),EmpresaID) AS EmpresaID,CONVERT(varchar(36),SocioID) AS SocioID,CONVERT(varchar(36),BotellaID) AS BotellaID,TipoMovimiento,GeneroCargo,MontoCargo,CONVERT(varchar(36),CargoConceptoID) AS CargoConceptoID,MotivoMovimiento,FechaMovimiento FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos ORDER BY FechaMovimiento DESC,MovimientoID DESC;

queries.name: cargo_movement_consumption_summary
queries.sql: SELECT TipoMovimiento,COUNT_BIG(*) AS movimientos,SUM(CASE WHEN GeneroCargo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_genero_cargo,SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(MontoCargo,0)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_monto_cargo,SUM(CASE WHEN c.CargoID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS con_cargo_relacionado FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos m LEFT JOIN dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos c ON c.MovimientoID=m.MovimientoID GROUP BY TipoMovimiento ORDER BY TipoMovimiento;

queries.name: cargo_movement_consumption_detail
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CONVERT(varchar(36),m.MovimientoID) AS MovimientoID,m.TipoMovimiento,m.GeneroCargo,m.MontoCargo,CONVERT(varchar(36),c.CargoID) AS CargoID,c.TipoCargo,c.Monto AS CargoMonto,c.Impuesto,c.Total,c.EstatusCargo,m.FechaMovimiento FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos m LEFT JOIN dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos c ON c.MovimientoID=m.MovimientoID WHERE m.TipoMovimiento LIKE N'CONSUMO%' ORDER BY m.FechaMovimiento DESC,m.MovimientoID DESC;

queries.name: cargo_movement_inconsistencies
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS inconsistent_rows FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos m LEFT JOIN dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos c ON c.MovimientoID=m.MovimientoID WHERE (c.CargoID IS NOT NULL AND (ISNULL(m.GeneroCargo,0)<>1 OR ISNULL(m.MontoCargo,0)<>ISNULL(c.Monto,0))) OR (c.CargoID IS NULL AND (ISNULL(m.GeneroCargo,0)=1 OR ISNULL(m.MontoCargo,0)>0));

queries.name: cargo_movement_inconsistency_detail
queries.sql: SELECT TOP 100 CONVERT(varchar(36),m.MovimientoID) AS MovimientoID,m.TipoMovimiento,m.GeneroCargo,m.MontoCargo,CONVERT(varchar(36),c.CargoID) AS CargoID,c.Monto AS CargoMonto,c.Total AS CargoTotal,m.FechaMovimiento FROM dbo.CavaSocios_Movimientos m LEFT JOIN dbo.CavaSocios_Cargos c ON c.MovimientoID=m.MovimientoID WHERE (c.CargoID IS NOT NULL AND (ISNULL(m.GeneroCargo,0)<>1 OR ISNULL(m.MontoCargo,0)<>ISNULL(c.Monto,0))) OR (c.CargoID IS NULL AND (ISNULL(m.GeneroCargo,0)=1 OR ISNULL(m.MontoCargo,0)>0)) ORDER BY m.FechaMovimiento DESC,m.MovimientoID DESC;

constraints: Do not publish Gate13B R2 from this job
Fail closed if SQL evidence cannot distinguish movement metadata from cargo table truth
